summary: Help the Shark Family and rescue sea life!
description:
In the crisis-ridden undersea world, animals may get into trouble at any time! The kind Shark Family is always ready to help animals out. Come and join them now! 

KNOW THE SHARK FAMILY
All family members have their own expertise: Grandma shark is good at cooking, Grandpa shark is good at building, Father shark is extremely strong, Mother shark is a cleaning expert, and Baby shark is very smart... No matter what the difficulties are, they can handle them! 

RECEIVE THE DISTRESS SIGNALS
Sea animals are in danger! Jellyfish have been trapped in a collapsed cave. How are they supposed to get out? The coral reef was polluted and the fish have lost their amusement park. Who will help them? It's Shark Family's showtime! 

COMPLETE THE RESCUE TASKS
Rally now, Shark Family! Turn into mechanical sharks and save sea animals. Father Shark is rescuing jellyfish that have been trapped in the cave while Grandpa Shark is ready to design a new amusement park for fish. Kids, let's help them! 

Other sea animals like sea turtles and seahorses have also sent out distress signals. Join the Shark Family now to implement new undersea tasks! 

FEATURES: 
- Embark on an adventure with 5 Shark Family members. 
- All Shark Family members can turn into mechanical sharks. 
- 6 types of sea animals await your rescue, such as sea turtles, seahorses and fish. 
- 10 rescue tasks need your assist, such as escorting the polar bears and guarding the treasure temple.
